text: Manon rang this morning. Her sister Yara is pregnant again, due around the 3rd of March. Remind me to send Yara a card once they've announced it properly.

Lunch with Arjun. His mum is coming over from Pune on 14 November and staying until Christmas. He's slightly dreading it. She hasn't been since the twins were born, so it'll be the first time she meets them properly. He wants to take her to Bath for a day and asked if I knew anywhere good for lunch. I'll send him the name of that place on the river.
The christening for Femi's daughter is Sunday 9th at 11am at St Mark's. I'm doing the cake.
Need to call Stefan back tomorrow evening about the weekend.
Hugo and his partner have had the baby! A boy, born on the 17th at 4:20am, called Theo. Must send flowers to the house this week.
Rachel mentioned her brother Colm has just been made redundant. She thinks he's taking it badly. I should check in with him at some point.
Coffee with Mustafa. His wife is expecting twins in the spring and they're looking for a bigger flat. He wants to be in Walthamstow by April.
Mehmet's dad has his hip operation on 22/11. Don't forget to message Mehmet the day after to see how it went.
Nia says her little one, Elijah, starts nursery on the 4th of January. She's more nervous than he is.
Dinner at Joy's on Friday at 7.30 is off; her kids have both got chickenpox.
Gareth and Tendai are coming up to visit on the 28th. I've booked the table at the Italian for 8pm.
Spoke to Rahul on the phone. His girlfriend Dalia is eight weeks pregnant, but she's had awful morning sickness. They aren't telling people until the 12-week scan on 2 December.
Kaito loves anything to do with vintage cameras. Worth remembering for his birthday.
Remind me to ask Joe how his sister's baby shower went on Saturday.
Catalina's mum is visiting from Bogotá for three weeks from the 6th. Catalina wants to take her to Edinburgh for a long weekend.
Pick up the dry cleaning before 5pm on Thursday.
Mabel told me her grandson was christened last Sunday. She showed me about forty photos. Her daughter-in-law made the gown herself.

Hana's partner Saanvi has a job interview in Manchester on Tuesday at 10am. If she gets it they'll move in the new year. Hana is a bit anxious about leaving her mum, who's been unwell since the summer. Saanvi's really nervous about the interview too; it's a panel of four and she has to give a presentation. Remind me to text her good luck on Monday night.
Alina's brother Stefan is getting married on 18 July in Kraków. She's asked whether I'd like to come. I need to let her know by the end of the month.
Francesca had her twenty-week scan yesterday. Everything looks fine and they've decided not to find out the sex.
Valentina's dog Biscuit is having an operation on his leg on Wednesday morning. She's really worried about him.
Met Imani and her husband at the school gate. Their eldest, Bethany, has just got into the county youth orchestra. She plays the cello.
Must post Amy's present by the 10th so it arrives for her birthday on the 13th.

Yosef said his wife's due date is the 1st of February, but the midwife thinks the baby might come early. He's trying to finish the kitchen before then, and his brother is meant to be helping but keeps cancelling. He also mentioned his wife has gone off coffee completely, which he finds hilarious. I should offer to help with the painting one weekend, maybe the 22nd or 29th.
Arjun's sister Saanvi had a little girl on Tuesday night. Mum and baby are both well, and they're calling her Mira.
Femi is struggling a bit since his dad moved in with them. The kids are sharing a room and nobody's sleeping. Remind me to ring him on Sunday afternoon for a proper chat.
I'm going to Leeds on 30 November and back on the 2nd. Need to sort the train tickets tonight.
Rachel O'Brien (Rach) from the book club is pregnant with her third. She said it was a bit of a surprise, but a happy one.
Mustafa's daughter Yara turns five on 8 December. He says she's obsessed with dinosaurs and would love a proper fossil kit.

Had a long call with Nia this evening. Her mum, who lives on her own in Cardiff, had a fall last week and is now in hospital waiting for a scan on Thursday. Nia's going down on Friday morning and will probably stay until the 21st. Her brother Gareth can't get time off work, so it's all landing on her. She sounded exhausted. I should drop round on Wednesday with some food for the kids and offer to have them after school.
Hugo and Manon have postponed the christening; Manon's mum can't travel until the spring. No new date yet.
Joy said Kaito has started a new job at the hospital in Bristol. He's on nights for the first month.
Remember to send Dalia the link to the pram she was asking about.
Elijah and his wife Mabel are celebrating their 40th wedding anniversary on 26 October. Their kids are throwing a surprise lunch at the golf club at 1pm on the Sunday.

Text from Colm: the baby came early! Little Rosa was born at 6am on the 15th, a bit small but doing well. His partner is still in hospital for a couple of days. Must sort a card and a present from all of us this week, and ask him when would be a good time to visit.

Bumped into Tendai at the station. Her son is starting secondary school in September and they're still choosing between two schools. Open evening is the 3rd at 6pm. Her husband prefers the one nearer home, but Tendai likes the music department at the other. Their younger one, Joy, is only in Year 2 so there's no rush there.
Gareth Walsh told me his wife Joy's waters broke on the drive back from her mum's yesterday. Baby Owen arrived at 2am. Gareth sounded completely shattered but over the moon.
Book the dentist for some time after the 12th.
Rahul is going to be a godfather to Arjun's son. The christening's on 7 June at 2pm, and he's terrified of having to do a reading.
Catalina and Joe are coming for Sunday lunch on the 23rd. Joe doesn't eat pork. Catalina is six months pregnant and can't have soft cheese, so I'll do the beef.

Spoke to Amy. Her partner Hana proposed on holiday in Lisbon! They're thinking of a small wedding next summer, possibly the 14th of June. Hana's parents are thrilled; Amy's dad is being a bit quiet about it, which has upset her. They want to tell everyone properly at Amy's birthday drinks on Saturday at 8pm.
Need to ask Alina how her dad's results were on Monday.
Valentina Lopez's son Hugo has his driving test on Thursday at 9.15. Don't forget to text him good luck on Wednesday night.
Francesca's brother Mehmet and his wife have just adopted a rescue cat called Pesto. Francesca says Mehmet already sends her ten photos a day.
Imani told me her mum's 70th is on 2 March. They're planning a family meal and want to make a photo book of her life. Imani asked if I had any old pictures of her mum from church.

Stefan's new baby is called Kasia. He finally sent a photo. She was born on 1 October in the end, after a long labour, and his wife Alina is recovering at her mum's in Gdańsk. Stefan flies back out to join them on Friday morning. I need to post the little cardigan before he goes.
Must remember: Yosef's kids, Amy and Joe, are in the nativity at St Luke's on the 16th at half 2. He's asked me to come along.

Call with Mehmet. His sister Dalia has split up with her fiancé, so the wedding in May is off. She's moved back in with their parents for now. Mehmet says she's putting on a brave face but is really low. I'll message her this weekend, nothing heavy, just to see if she fancies a walk.
Arjun said his partner wants a nice leather notebook for Christmas. He keeps dropping hints, apparently.
Bethany is due on the 9th of April, so the baby shower is pencilled in for Saturday 14 March at 3pm at her sister's. Remind me to find out what she still needs from the list.
Garden centre tomorrow morning, then pick up compost and bulbs.
Femi's wife has her first scan on Monday at 11:40. He's taking the morning off work.
Joe and Catalina are moving into their new house on 12/12. Joe's mum is having their daughter for the weekend so they can unpack.
Message Saanvi on Friday to see whether the christening date is confirmed, and then book the hotel.
Rachel's partner Nia has been signed off with stress for a month. Rachel is holding everything together but she's tired. I should take her out for coffee next week, maybe Tuesday.
Kaito Le is a big fan of the Hammers and has a season ticket. His dad used to take him to Upton Park.
Sorted the flowers for Mum's birthday. They'll be delivered on the 19th, before 12.

Tendai's brother is getting married in Harare in August, so the whole family is flying out on the 2nd. She's already worried about the kids on such a long flight. Remind me to ask her about it when she's back.
Colm's son Elijah was baptised on Sunday morning. I couldn't make it, so I need to send him a card and the money for the savings account.
Lovely chat with Mrs Shah next door. Her granddaughter Imani has just started at Durham and she misses her terribly. She's knitting her a scarf for when she comes home on 15 December.
